body:
LiveStream Studio 1.0.10
A B2R desktop app for broadcasting pre-recorded playlists.

WHAT’S NEW
• New B2R logo and app icon.
• Fixed a video-clock reset that could cause audio/video drift when a clip’s colour metadata changes during repeated playback.
• Edit existing schedules and stopped stream destinations.
• Editable daily start times, with time limits or complete-playlist loop limits.
• Paste stream keys while they remain hidden.
• Explicit, optional key storage and improved reconnect diagnostics.
• Prepared-media playback and shared encoding for matching destinations.

DOWNLOADS
Choose your platform at https://stream.b2r.it.com/#/download. The installer starts downloading directly from the button.

PLATFORMS
macOS: Apple Silicon. Locally built DMG, ad-hoc signed and not Developer ID notarized.
Windows: 64-bit EXE/MSI installers. Not Authenticode signed.
Linux: x86_64 AppImage, DEB and RPM packages. Bundled FFmpeg requires a compatible glibc-based system.

UPDATE NOTES
Finish your current broadcast before updating. Keep the desktop app open for scheduled streams and prepare session keys after restarting. macOS wake alarms are platform-specific; other systems must stay awake for scheduled starts.

Third-party licence notices and FFmpeg build/source information are included with the app. SHA256SUMS.txt lists the hashes of the installers attached to this release.
